messages:
Riley Chen: Hey folks 026-03-30 my child turned 26 and lives in Canada on a study permit. Carrier said they age out and coverage ends. What are options for continuation? Can they elect COBRA from abroad or get direct billing?
Samira Khan: Short answer: dependent coverage under our plans ends at the end of the month they turn 26 (so 2026-03-31). They may be eligible for COBRA/continuation if the carrier/COBRA vendor covers that event. International address is fine for notices, but enrollment/election paperwork must go through the COBRA vendor.
Riley Chen: Do we initiate COBRA, or does my child need to do something? Timeline?
BenefitsAdmin: We submit the QLE/termination to the COBRA vendor once you confirm dependent removal. Vendor will mail the COBRA packet to the dependent's address on file. They then have the standard election period (usually 60 days) to elect COBRA. If they elect, vendor will set up billing. Note: some carriers require premium payments in USD and payment methods that work from Canada (credit card/bank ACH).
Global Mobility: For employees with dependents overseas: ensure the dependent address is uploaded to the secure portal so the COBRA vendor uses the correct mailing address. If the dependent cannot receive physical mail, vendor can sometimes accept an emailed election packet if we request it.
Riley Chen: My kid doesn't have SSN; they have a Canadian SIN. Will that block COBRA or claims later if they elect?
Samira Khan: COBRA enrollment does not require SSN at election time, but carriers often ask for SSN for claims/payroll reconciliation. If they don't have an SSN, they can provide foreign tax ID (SIN) and we can note that. If they later obtain a US SSN or ITIN, upload via secure portal to update records.
Riley Chen: Is there any way to extend dependent coverage through school status or disability? They are a full-time student but age 26 now.
BenefitsAdmin: Most of our carriers follow the standard age limit; school status rarely extends coverage past 26 under federal rules. Disability exceptions exist but require documentation and SSA proof of disability that began before age limit and continuous coverage; that is a high bar. If you think disability applies, upload medical/disability documentation and we'll review with carrier.
Riley Chen: Ok. What docs do you need from me to start COBRA and to remove them as dependent?
Samira Khan: Please upload to secure portal: 1) Dependent birth certificate or passport (showing DOB) 2) Proof of Canadian address (utility or lease) 3) If you want COBRA: a short signed note requesting vendor notification and mailing address. Use subject "Dependent Termination/COBRA". Link: https://hr.redwood.com/secure-upload Do NOT post PII here.
Riley Chen: Uploaded "1809991111_riley_dept_term.zip" with passport + lease + signed request.
People Ops Bot: Reminder: use secure upload for PII. Link: https://hr.redwood.com/secure-upload.
BenefitsAdmin: Received files. We'll submit the termination to the COBRA vendor today and request emailed packet in addition to mailed packet because international mail can be slow. Expect vendor to confirm within 3 business days.
PayrollOps: FYI 026: if COBRA is elected, premiums will be billed to the dependent directly by the vendor. No payroll deduction changes needed unless you request premium stop immediately. If refund of premiums is required for retro coverage, well coordinate with carrier.
Riley Chen: Thanks all. One last Q: can my child be listed as a primary on voluntary student accident plan instead of on my medical if COBRA isn't workable?
Samira Khan: Some voluntary plans (student accident, supplemental) allow direct purchase by the student depending on the carrier. We can share the vendor links once COBRA outcome is known. We'll message you the options off-channel.
BenefitsAdmin: Updating thread: COBRA vendor confirmed receipt 2026-04-01 and will send email packet to "riley.child@example.ca" and physical packet to the Canadian address on file. We'll post vendor tracking here when available.
Riley Chen: Got it 026-04-01 thanks. Appreciate the help.
